para.idea: the power cut during the big football final
para.title: ফুটবল ফাইনাল ও লোডশেডিংয়ের রহস্য! ⚽⚡ (পর্ব ১)
para.summary: It is the evening of the big local football cup final, and the entire neighborhood has gathered in Kaku's living room to watch the match on his big television. Tensions run high as the match reaches the 89th minute tied at 1-1. Suddenly, the entire neighborhood goes pitch black due to a transformer fault. Dadu, Bhombol-da, Mashima, and Kaku panic while Kaku's phone battery dies. The clever young Saheb-da suggests searching for Dadu's old battery-operated radio in the dusty attic to listen to the live commentary. Saheb and Bhombol-da head upstairs and fetch the vintage radio, but discover it lacks heavy-duty batteries. Saheb goes outside to search for batteries at the local club. Outside in the dark street, Saheb hears a suspicious metallic snip near the street transformer and spots a shadowy figure in a raincoat holding wire cutters. Saheb realizes the power cut wasn't an accident, but before he can confront the stranger, a massive cheering shout erupts from the neighboring alley.
para.part2_plan: In Part 2, Saheb confronts the mysterious sabotager who turns out to be a mischievous rival fan from the neighboring para trying to delay the match. Saheb clever-mindedly resolves the fuse issue with the help of the local electrician. Meanwhile, Bhombol-da and Dadu manage to power the vintage radio using flashlight batteries using a bent paperclip hack Saheb taught them. The family reunites around the radio just in time to hear the legendary final goal and celebrate their para's victory together with hot tea and snacks.

characters.name: Saheb
characters.look: friendly calm clever Bengali young man about 32, soft oval face with slightly full cheeks, gentle confident smile, brown eyes behind rectangular black-framed glasses, thick straight black eyebrows, short thick black hair brushed forward with a soft fringe, clean-shaven, wheat-brown skin, teal half-sleeve shirt, dark-blue jeans, brown belt, black wristwatch, white sneakers

characters.name: Bhombol-da
characters.look: plump cheerful young man around 26, mop of wild curly black hair, bright red t-shirt, green checkered lungi, bare feet

characters.name: Dadu
characters.look: thin energetic old grandfather, bald top with white hair on sides, round metal-framed glasses, traditional white cotton dhoti-kurta, carrying a polished wooden walking stick

characters.name: Mashima
characters.look: plump kind middle-aged aunt, short black hair tied in a bun, wearing a white cotton sari with a thick red border, big round red bindi on forehead

characters.name: Kaku
characters.look: bald middle-aged uncle, thick black moustache, round stomach, wearing a blue checked short-sleeved shirt and gray trousers, always holding a smartphone

para.last_lines: ঠিক তখনই পাশের পাড়া থেকে একসাথে শতেক মানুষের গগনবিদারী চিল চিৎকার ভেসে এল! / গোল! পাশের পাড়ায় কি গোল হয়ে গেল সাহেবদা? নাকি ফিউজ খোলা রহস্যময় লোকটা ওদের লোক? / কে কাটল পাড়ার কারেন্ট? আর শেষ পর্যন্ত ফাইনাল কাপ কার ঘরে গেল? জানতে দেখুন আগামীকাল দ্বিতীয় পর্ব!
para.setting: A bustling narrow Kolkata neighborhood lane (para) in the evening, with vintage brick houses, open balconies, glowing street lamps before power cut, colorful football flags hanging across trees, and Kaku's traditional cozy living room decorated with football posters.

folk.idea: the magic birds Byangoma and Byangomi who give advice
folk.title: রূপোলি গাছের ডালে গোপন রহস্য? 🌳✨ (পর্ব ১)
folk.summary: Prince Neel sets out on a dangerous journey to the magical Demon Realm to find the Golden Lotus that can wake his father, King Bikram, from a mysterious sleeping curse. On his way, he meets Saheb, a calm and clever young traveler who guides him to the ancient Banyan Tree where the legendary magic birds, Byangoma and Byangomi, reside. Overhearing the birds' secret conversation, Neel and Saheb learn that touching the Demon River turns anyone to stone unless protected by a magic golden feather. After solving the birds' tricky riddle, Byangomi gifts them a shining feather and warns them of the Rakkhosh's sleeping flute. Part 1 ends at midnight at the misty riverbank, where a terrifying Demon Guard suddenly rises from the roaring waters to crush them.
folk.part2_plan: In Part 2, Saheb uses his wits and the golden feather's magic to outsmart the Demon Guard without fighting. They sneak into the Demon Queen's palace using the sleeping flute's charm in reverse. Neel retrieves the Golden Lotus with Saheb's clever distractions. Returning to Rupnagar, Neel touches his father with the Lotus, reviving the King and restoring light to the kingdom.

characters.name: Prince Neel
characters.look: brave handsome young prince around 18 years old, slender athletic build, fair skin, large expressive dark brown eyes, neat black shoulder-length hair, wearing a royal blue silk angrakha kurta with golden embroidery, white pyjamas, a small gold crown on his head

characters.name: Saheb
characters.look: friendly calm clever Bengali young man about 32, soft oval face with slightly full cheeks, gentle confident smile, brown eyes behind rectangular black-framed glasses, thick straight black eyebrows, short thick black hair brushed forward with a soft fringe, clean-shaven (no moustache, no beard), wheat-brown skin, maroon kurta with small gold buttons, cream dhoti, cream shawl with a thin gold border over the left shoulder, small brown cloth shoulder bag, brown nagra shoes

characters.name: Byangoma
characters.look: majestic magical male bird, golden and crimson feathers, sharp intelligent eyes, glowing crown of feathers, larger than an eagle

characters.name: Byangomi
characters.look: gentle magical female bird, silver and sapphire blue feathers, soft bright eyes, graceful posture, glowing aura around her feathers

characters.name: Demon Guard
characters.look: tall shadowy mythical demon figure with dark purple skin, glowing yellow eyes, pointed ears, wearing brass shoulder guards and holding a huge wooden club

folk.last_lines: হঠাৎই নদীর বুক চিরে উঠে দাঁড়াল এক বিশাল দানব 'রক্তনেত্র'! তার চোখ দুটি জ্বলন্ত আগুনের গোলা আর হাতে বিরাট কাঁটাওয়ালা গদা! / হাহা হা! কার এত বড় সাহস যে আমার অনুমতি ছাড়া রাক্ষসপুরীর সীমানায় পা দেয়? তোদের এখানেই পিষে মারব! / সাহেব ভাই! দানবের ভয়ে আমার হাত কেঁপে পালকটা খসে যাচ্ছে! বাঁচাও! / বিশাল গদা তেড়ে আসছে নিচে! সোনার পালকও হাত থেকে নদীর গভীরে খসে পড়ার মুখে! কিন্তু চতুর সাহেব কি পারবে এই ভয়ঙ্কর দানবকে নিজের বুদ্ধি দিয়ে পরাস্ত করতে? জানতে হলে অপেক্ষা করুন আগামী পর্বের জন্য!
folk.setting: Ancient magical forest bordering Rupnagar, twilight shifting to midnight, giant banyan tree with glowing leaves, deep misty river, starry sky
